evidence: Tac. Hist. 1.21; Ann. 1.25; Varr. LL 5.91 (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The deputy a centurion chose for himself (optāre, to choose; Festus, in Lewis & Short). Distinguish optiō f., choice.

sources: Lewis & Short: optio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 188.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
